ToT Altar as Adult.message:
An awakening voice from the Sacred Realm will call those destined to be Sages, who dwell in the five temples. Kakariko Village... Kakariko Village... Bottom of the Well... Kakariko Village... Hyrule Castle... Forest Temple... The awakened ones will await for the Hero to find Greg. And the evil one's key will be hidden somewhere
in Hyrule. And the Triforce will be granted once 25 Triforce Pieces are retrieved. Together with the Hero of Time, the awakened ones will return the light of peace to the world...
